The batch therefore moves from isolated strong-condition probes toward matched local grids, especially around m125, m159, m177, m141, m128, and m96, while retaining donor-free and compact ester controls.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines four local response grids, loading contrasts, high-value finish-tail probes, and ordinary controls. The m125 and m159 sets repair repeated scaffold-specific onset and finish errors; m177 and m173 probe whether extreme V2 tails turn on abruptly with strength; m96 tests a recent overestimated tail; and m141, m211, and m128 extend late-retention calibration across related heteroatom-rich families. The m74, m136, m2, m3, and m31 controls constrain transfer of those corrections into compact donor-free and acceptor-only rows. This mixture should improve generalization by covering both failure regions and the ordinary portion of the Row-distribution, with condition contrasts that let retraining identify structure-condition interactions rather than memorizing isolated labels."}
